|quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Icicle Mine''' throws a [[mine]] that when detonated fires several long-range icicle projectiles in random directions that deal [[cold damage]], launching more icicles with more consecutive mine detonated. The mines have an [[aura]] which grants increased [[critical strike]] chance against enemies in the aura. ==Skill Functions and Interactions== * The innate aura effect of this skill ({{c|mod|Each Mine applies 10% increased Critical Strike Chance to Hits against Enemies near it, up to a maximum of 500%}}) has a base radius [[distance]] of 3.5 metre and are scaled by modifiers to area, including those specific to auras.{{cite web|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3324396/page/2#p24823327|title=Re: On the High Impact Mine Support Gem, what radius does nearby have and will it scale with modifiers?|date=December 5, 2022|accessdate=June 10, 2024|author=Bex_GGG|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums}} Increased aura effect will improve the bonus per mine near an enemy, but will not affect the maximum bonus. ** This modifier applies globally, and can be used to add crit chance to other skills by maximizing the mine duration without detonating it. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression | c1_abbr = Cold
Damage | c1_header = Deals x to y Cold Damage | c1_pattern_extract = Deals (%d+) to (%d+) Cold Damage | c1_pattern_value = %d to %d }} {{Item acquisition}} {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} ==Legacy artwork== {| | [[File:Icicle Mine legacy inventory icon.png|78px]] || Icicle Mine gems dropped before [[version 3.8.0]] retain their legacy artwork in [[permanent leagues]]. |} {{Alternate skill effect list}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Alternate quality gems, labyrinth helmet enchantments and unique threshold jewels are all systems that were trying to subtly modify the behaviour of skills. With this expansion these have been combined into a new system called Transfigured Gems that allows us to fully achieve the goal of these three systems, and then some. * Quality now causes the skill to Fire +0-2 Projectiles, instead of providing 0-20% increased Projectile Speed. * Anomalous, Divergent and Phantasmal Quality Gems have been removed from the game. Existing alternate Quality Gems now have the base Quality effect found on the respective Gem. * Helmet enchantments are no longer obtainable from the [[Divine Font]]. At the same time, new variants of the Icicle Mine: {{il|Icicle Mine of Fanning}} and {{il|Icicle Mine of Sabotage}}, are obtainable from the font. }} {{Version history table row|3.12.0| * Now has alternate quality: ** {{C|gem|Anomalous Icicle Mine}}: {{c|mod|Fires 0.1 additional Projectiles}} (per 1% gem quality; break points are 10% and 20% and so on) ** {{C|gem|Divergent Icicle Mine}}: {{c|mod|1% increased Critical Strike Chance}} (per 1% gem quality) }} {{Version history table row|3.9.0| * Icicle Mine was providing enormous area coverage and damage at very little cost, and was also causing performance problems. These changes are intended to bring Icicle Mine in line with other mines, as well as alleviate the performance issues it was causing. * The projectiles now fade over time, similar to Freezing Pulse, but without the gradual damage drop-off. In other words, the mines will have a shorter range by default, but can be increased by increasing the skill's Projectile Speed. * Now has 4 additional projectiles at all levels (from 6 at gem level 20). * Now gains 1% increased Projectile Speed per 1% gem quality (from 1% increased Projectile Damage per 1% gem quality). }} {{Version history table row|3.8.0| * Freeze Mine (now named Icicle Mine) * Has been completely reworked, and is now a blue gem with minimum level 12. * Deals 16 to 24 Cold Damage at gem level 1, up to 514 to 771 at gem level 20. * Base mine detonation time is 0.3 seconds. * Fires 4 additional projectiles at gem level 1, up to 6 at gem level 20. * Each mine applies 10% increased Critical Strike Chance to Hits against Enemies near it, up to a maximum of 500%. * Fires an additional projectile for every 2 prior Mines in Detonation Sequence. * Added Icicle Mine as a quest reward for the Shadow, and as purchasable from Nessa for the Witch, Templar and Scion, for completing The Siren's Cadence. * Existing helmet enchantments that grant {{c|enchanted|8/12% increased Freeze Mine Area of Effect}} or {{c|enchanted|Freeze Mine causes Enemies to lose an additional 8/12% [[Cold Resistance]] while [[Freeze|Frozen]]}} have been converted to {{c|enchanted| Icicle [[Mine]] has 8/12% increased Throwing Speed}}. Both versions are unobtainable in [[Divine Font]]. The obtainable version in the Divine Font grants {{c|enchanted|10% or 15% increased Throwing Speed}} instead. {{undocumented}} }} {{Version history table row|3.6.0| * Mana Cost at gem level 1 is now 7 (was 6). * Mana Cost at gem level 20 is now 20 (was 22). }} {{Version history table row|2.0.0| * All trap and mine skills have had their trap and mine duration reduced to 16 seconds. This includes the support gems Trap and Remote Mine. * Mana cost reduced at all levels. }} {{Version history table row|1.0.5| * Freeze Mine now deals damage, increasing as it goes up in levels. * It always freezes and the freeze duration is longer than the damage would normally cause. }} {{Version history table row|0.11.6| * Freeze Mine now gives enemies it freezes a 15% penalty to Cold [[Resistance]]. * The imaginary freeze damage used to calculate the freeze duration for Freeze Mine has been increased at higher levels. It is 15% more effective by level 15. * {{il|Added Cold Damage Support}} now affects Freeze Mine's freeze effect. * Curse cast speed no longer affects Freeze Mine cast time. }} {{Version history table row|0.11.4| * Freeze mine can now be supported by {{il|Cold Penetration Support}}. }} {{Version history table row|0.10.8| * Freeze Mine has had its cast time for laying the mine decreased to 500ms from 1 second. }} {{Version history table row|0.10.0| * Improved by 37.5% }} {{Version history table row|0.9.11g| * Fixed a bug where {{il|Elemental Proliferation Support}} would not work with Freeze Mine. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.9| * Freeze Mine has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} == References == {{reflist}} {{Navbox Skills}}
